method_notes: old_connector_exact reproduces parent 0438349: extract_kv_blocks followed by torch.stack for each of 28 layers.
old_transfer_only times only _extract_kv_blocks_stacked, whose .cpu() includes pageable allocation and synchronous D2H.
new_async_exact invokes the unchanged AsyncKVExtractionBatch at commit 5ae131d.
Exact paths are interleaved in forward/reverse order and synchronized before each call.
pinned_event_wait_including_copy_completion is not pure event API overhead; idle_event_record_sync separately measures an idle event.
pinned_cuda_copy_span uses CUDA events around preallocated pinned copies and includes host enqueue gaps on the same stream.
device_contiguous_clone is a hypothetical extra contiguous GPU copy; the actual extracted source is already contiguous.
Input generation is seeded; all measured extraction operations are deterministic.
